explication: Kustomize builds Kubernetes configuration from a kustomization file and raw YAML resources, applying declared generators and transformations to produce customized YAML without changing the source files. The main path runs from the CLI through the build command and Kustomizer into target loading and resource accumulation, then generates and transforms resources before output. Overlays and bases, editing and localization commands, and plugin-based extensions are separate product capabilities. The README describes the user workflow; the tree supports the subsystem paths, but unsampled implementation details limit some internal wiring.
